section_order: Hero with headline and CTA > Logo bar or testimonial strip > Feature grid (3-4 cards) > Detailed feature sections > Testimonials > Pricing > Final CTA
cta_placement: Primary CTA in hero and repeated after testimonials. Secondary CTA after features.
color_strategy: Hero uses primary bg or gradient. Features alternate white and light bg. CTA sections use primary with white text.
effects: Staggered hero entrance (heading then subtext then CTA). Feature cards fade in on scroll. Testimonial carousel auto-play.
conversion_tips: Logo bar immediately after hero builds instant credibility. Keep hero CTA to ONE action. Repeat CTA after every proof section.

section_order: Hero showing transformation > Before/After showcase > Process steps > Results/testimonials > Packages > CTA
cta_placement: CTA after the before/after section when desire peaks. Repeat after testimonials.
color_strategy: High contrast between before (muted desaturated) and after (vibrant saturated). CTA in accent color.
effects: Before/after slider interaction. Smooth reveal animations. Counter animations for results.
conversion_tips: Show the transformation FIRST. Numbers and percentages beat vague claims. Make the before state relatable.

section_order: Hero with credentials > Trust badges and certifications > Services overview > Team profiles > Case studies > Contact form
cta_placement: Contact form visible in hero or sticky sidebar. Phone number in header always.
color_strategy: Conservative palette. Navy or dark primary. Gold or green accents for trust badges. White backgrounds.
effects: Minimal animation. Subtle fade-ins only. Credential badges with hover detail. Smooth scroll to sections.
conversion_tips: Lead with credentials not creativity. Show the team — these industries sell people. Phone number must be visible at all times.

section_order: Full-bleed hero image > Portfolio masonry grid > About/approach > Selected projects detail > Testimonials > Contact
cta_placement: Minimal CTAs. One in nav one after portfolio. Let the work sell.
color_strategy: Monochrome or muted palette so the portfolio work is the color. Dark mode works well.
effects: Image hover reveals. Lightbox gallery. Smooth page transitions. Parallax on hero.
conversion_tips: The work IS the marketing. Minimize text maximize visuals. Category filters help visitors find relevant work.

section_order: Hero with booking CTA > Services with prices > Reviews > About/team > FAQ > Booking form
cta_placement: Booking CTA in hero sticky on mobile and repeated after reviews. Phone number in header.
color_strategy: Warm inviting palette. CTA in high-contrast accent. Service cards on white or light bg.
effects: Subtle hover on service cards. Smooth scroll to booking. Star rating animations. Calendar widget integration.
conversion_tips: Put the booking path front and center. Show ratings near the top. Include price ranges — people comparison-shop services. FAQ reduces booking friction.

section_order: Hero with food photography > Menu highlights or full menu > Location and hours > Reservation > Gallery > About
cta_placement: Reservation CTA in hero and nav. Sticky mobile bar with call and reserve buttons.
color_strategy: Warm appetizing palette. Dark mode with warm accents works for upscale. Light for casual.
effects: Food image parallax. Menu category tabs. Smooth reveal on menu items. Map integration.
conversion_tips: Menu must be native HTML not a PDF link. Hours and location above the fold for mobile. Professional food photography is non-negotiable.

section_order: Hero with phone number and emergency CTA > Services > Service areas > Reviews > About > FAQ
cta_placement: Giant phone number in hero. Click-to-call on mobile. Emergency banner if applicable.
color_strategy: High contrast for urgency. Blue for trust with orange or red CTA. Clean white background.
effects: Minimal animation — speed is priority. Fast load times. Sticky call button on mobile.
conversion_tips: Phone number must be the most visible element. Load time under 2 seconds — emergency customers bounce fast. Show service area prominently.

section_order: Hero with product > Feature breakdown > How it works > Social proof > Comparison > Pricing > FAQ > CTA
cta_placement: Buy CTA in hero sticky on scroll. Repeated after comparison and FAQ.
color_strategy: Product-focused. Clean white for product shots. Accent color for buy buttons only.
effects: Product image zoom. Smooth scroll between sections. Feature reveal animations. Price toggle for variants.
conversion_tips: One product one page one CTA. Remove all navigation distractions. Comparison section against alternatives builds confidence.

section_order: Hero with personal photo > Story or method > Results > Testimonials > Services > Booking
cta_placement: Booking CTA after results section when trust peaks. Secondary CTA in hero.
color_strategy: Personal and warm. Use colors that complement the personal photo. Avoid corporate cold palettes.
effects: Personal photo parallax. Testimonial carousel. Result counter animations. Smooth scroll.
conversion_tips: Your face must be above the fold — people buy people. Lead with results not biography. One clear offer not a menu of 10 services.

section_order: Hero with value prop > What you get > Member results > Preview or sample > Pricing tiers > FAQ > Join CTA
cta_placement: Join CTA in hero after member results and after FAQ. Scarcity element if applicable.
color_strategy: Energetic palette. Community-feel colors. Purple or blue primary with warm accent CTA.
effects: Member count animation. Testimonial video embeds. Pricing card hover effects. Preview section peek.
conversion_tips: Show member results prominently. Preview content reduces uncertainty. Limited spots or cohort model creates urgency. Video testimonials outperform text 3:1.

section_order: Hero with location > Services > Service area map > Reviews > About > Contact form
cta_placement: Contact form and phone number always visible. CTA references the local area by name.
color_strategy: Trust-building palette. Local imagery in hero. Clean and professional.
effects: Map integration. Area highlight on hover. Review carousel. Simple contact form.
conversion_tips: Mention the city or area name in the hero headline — local SEO and relevance. Google reviews embed is more trusted than manual testimonials. Show the service area clearly.
